divisions.title: The Locust Plague
divisions.summary: Locusts strip the land bare. Drunkards weep, priests mourn, grain and wine fail. A call to lament and return.

divisions.title: The Day of the LORD
divisions.theme: Judgment, repentance, and the Spirit poured out
divisions.summary: Locust army becomes apocalyptic invasion. Rend your hearts, not garments. The LORD relents and pours out his Spirit on all flesh.

divisions.title: Judgment and Restoration
divisions.summary: Valley of Decision. Nations gathered for judgment while Judah receives living waters and eternal dwelling.
